notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Divining Witch that doesn't have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
easyPrerequisites: Divining Witch doesn't have summoning sickness. You have a card in hand.
description:
Activate Divining Witch by paying {1}{B}, tapping it and discarding a card, naming a card not in your library and thus exiling your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using any creature. Fblthp triggers, causing you to win the game.
